summary: Backend-only testing of iter260 changes: shipping auto-pack (create + update), packing-unit stacking (parent_id set/clear), chat ghost-user filters (/chat/users + /chat/conversations), campus-switcher RBAC, /api/admin/users/directory, and list-endpoint regressions. New pytest suite: 20 tests, 18 passed, 2 failed. All shipping auto-pack + stacking behaviour and both chat ghost fixes verified working. One pre-existing HIGH RBAC leak found in PUT /api/user/active-campus. All Iter260_ test items/units/users were cleaned up (verified in Mongo).

critical.issue: Campus scope leak: a Director assigned ONLY to loc_39aa9967 (Haiti) + loc_9d988d24 (Kenya) can successfully switch to loc_419f5d5e (Uganda) — returns 200. Cause: server.py ~L286-306 first adds each assigned location's PARENT campus (loc_001) to user_locs, then adds ALL non-restricted sub-locations of everything in user_locs — which pulls in every sibling campus under loc_001. Restricted campuses are still correctly 403, and non-existent campus is 404. Fix: expand subs only from the user's DIRECTLY assigned locations, not from parents added during expansion.

minor.issue: Legacy packing unit pku_dd00a7 ('Test Box 99', no created_at) has no parent_id key at all (stale test data from an earlier iteration, inserted outside the API). Units created via POST /packing-units correctly include parent_id: null. Frontend stack-tower logic reads u.parent_id (undefined is falsy) so it degrades safely, but this leftover 'Test Box 99' should be removed from the production shipment.

action_items: Fix PUT /api/user/active-campus sibling-campus leak (server.py ~L286-306): do not derive allowed sub-locations from parent campuses added during expansion; only from the user's own location_ids/location_id (plus explicit sub-locations of those).
Delete stale packing unit pku_dd00a7 ('Test Box 99') from shipment sh_1091d195ee, or backfill parent_id: null on legacy units.
critical_code_review_comments: chat.py get_conversations: the campus block at L13-21 builds a query then immediately overwrites it with the participant-only query — dead code, remove it (get_campus_filter result is unused).

items.py update_item: the iter260 auto-pack snap is applied AFTER the field loop, so an explicit x_cm in the same PUT as packing_unit_id is silently discarded. That matches the spec but is worth a comment/response field so the UI doesn't think its coords were saved.
items.py is ~1500+ lines — consider splitting the AI scan/derive-shape sections out of the item CRUD module.

/api/chat/users includes 'Security Contractor' while /api/admin/users/directory does not. Two divergent STAFF_ROLES lists (chat.py L64 vs admin.py L19) — extract one shared constant in deps.py to keep the ghost-user/scope rules consistent.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASSING: (1) POST /shipments/{id}/items with packing_unit_id snaps x/y/z_cm to 0 and loose items keep their coords; (2) PUT item {packing_unit_id} resets x/y/z_cm to 0 and nulls floor_x_cm/floor_y_cm; unlinking (packing_unit_id:null) does not wipe coords; reads never mutate legacy non-zero coords; (3) PUT /packing-units/{id} {parent_id} stacks and {parent_id:null} un-stacks, unknown unit -> 404; (4) /chat/users excludes caller, inactive users and non-staff roles, all rows have id+name+staff role; (5) direct DM disappears from /chat/conversations after the counterparty is deleted while the group conversation survives; (6) /admin/users/directory is staff-only, no password_hash/_id, search filter works; (7) /events, /tasks, /shipments all return arrays. Only open backend bug = active-campus sibling leak. Frontend visualizer (drag-to-stack, stack tower, xN badge) was NOT tested per request.
rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/user/active-campus builds the allowed-campus set in three stages against the SAME mutable set: (1) user's location_ids + location_id, (2) parent_id of any of those, (3) every non-restricted location whose parent_id is in the set. Because stage 2 injects the top-level campus (loc_001), stage 3 then enumerates all of loc_001's children, granting a Director access to sibling campuses they were never assigned. Reproduce: create a Director with location_ids=[loc_39aa9967, loc_9d988d24], login, PUT /api/user/active-campus {campus_id: loc_419f5d5e} -> 200 (expected 403). Mitigation: compute sub-location expansion from the user's directly-assigned ids only, and keep parent campuses in a separate read-only set used for data filtering, not for switch authorisation.
